build.summary: V27 phase 1 is done on research/production-loop-20261116-w3-v27, head c998963d (10 commits, not pushed). The forward break-even pilot (FBP) Auto route follows OD-L1-22 D1-D6. New unified/breakeven.rs: break_even_length, a quota-1 DOPRI5 session loop with attempt telemetry, a located window, pilots at b*2^k, a horizon, and one RODAS5P attempt per pilot (h0=H, max_steps=1) under one budget. session.rs gains crate-private pass-throughs. The stiffness screen, the trial budget and the dimension limit are removed together with their public names, including UnifiedStop::Preflight. VigilodeSolution gains pilot records and a handover history entry. The 5 failing-first tests failed on the base by assertion and pass now. The numbers match the design model exactly (Robertson 385 vs 6233, L96 3233 vs 33467, osc_1000 35582, Arenstorf 1369, P_heat_fd 945<=5890). U1-U5, D1, session and b(n) tests were added. Router contracts: 2 D4 edits and 8 D5 edits, each listed in IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES.md. Suite (549 passed), clippy, rustdoc -D warnings, fmt and the unchanged golden test all pass. The loop checker reports only the 9 expected pins. The runner is built for N and T and passes the toy check; no problem of the deciding set was run.

finding_status.how: A fatal callback in a pilot ends the solve: stop is Rodas5p{CallbackFailed} and the DOPRI5 prefix up to t_D is kept (test d1_...).
A supplied Jacobian, JVP or band still gives RouteBasis::SuppliedDerivative, so RODAS5P starts.
The handover is one way. There is no return to DOPRI5.
The P_heat_fd and P_scalar_fd tests now check the work bound W plus a recorded handover; both tests were renamed *_is_bounded_and_hands_over.

EXPLICIT_TRIAL_MAX_DIMENSION, DOPRI5_REAL_STABILITY_BOUND, EXPLICIT_TRIAL_ATTEMPT_LIMIT, StiffnessScreen, the 5 RouteBasis values, UnifiedStop::Preflight and the PreflightAnalysis screen fields are removed.
Nothing was added: no price option. Operations are counted by formula outside the protected kernel.

rulings: The pilot runs through registry_leg, which calls Rodas5p::solve, which is solve_observed_bounded(.., &[], None). It is the same call and gives the route id from the run record.
The accepted pilot is merged into the RODAS5P leg (legs: DOPRI5, then RODAS5P), and that leg's history entry is the handover. This keeps contract_4 (route_history.len()==2) passing unchanged.
The PreflightAnalysis fields screen, rhs_calls and callback_failure are removed because they described the screen only.
The label case 'heat n=16 FD without structure' now declares regime Stiff. It depended on the removed dimension limit (D5).

Budget: the DOPRI5 session enforces max_steps alone until the first pilot attempt, so a pilot-free record equals Dopri5::solve. After that the route stops when DOPRI5 plus pilot attempts reach max_steps, and the status is MaxStepsReached{max_steps}.
The pilot window is kept only when b <= max_steps, so it holds at most min(b, max_steps) entries.
